name: Steelco Gujarat Limited
about: Steelco Gujarat Limited manufactures and sells cold-rolled steel products in India. The company offers CR steel sheet/coils/strips, CR galvanized plain/corrugated sheets/coils/strips, and pre painted galvanized sheets/coils; HRPO, CR, CRCA, and MCHC coils; and galvanized coils and corrugated sheet/plain products. It also provides hardened and tempered steel strips, HRGC coils, strips, sheets, and circles; mild steels; high and medium carbons; GP/GC coil sheets; and CR coils and sheets. In addition, the company rents properties. Its products are used in circular saw, cirlip, hairpin, chain, dowel pin, drop wire, hose clip, clutch plate, roof sheet, eyelets, two wheeler, refrigerator, perforated sheets, control panel, bicycle, stamping, precision tube, furniture, tobacco tin, and bearing cage, as well as drumps and barrels industries. The company also exports its products. Steelco Gujarat Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Vadodara, India.
